outcome: medical or psychiatric hospitalization associated with depression (HAWD)
cohort: The study included 243,933 women delivering 348,273 live infants in British Columbia between 1999 and 2009.
finding: Mothers from low-income areas had increased odds of hospitalization associated with depression (HAWD) compared to those from middle-income areas, with even higher odds observed in those with depression and no antidepressant use.
